notes: Compact manual-defrost chest freezer. Covers revision DW0 only, and later revisions may use other part numbers.

gaps: The cover voltage is for the product; the catalog gives no voltage for the compressor itself, so none is set on it.
Neither the catalog nor the service data sheet 216787900 lists a separate start relay or overload.
That controller is classed as a relay here because a parts price listing names 216954200 a start relay device.
What it contains is not documented.
These are performance figures, not ratings, so they are not put in rating fields.
Capacity conflict: Abt's product page says 7.0 cu. ft.; the Energy Guide label (same number 216793915 as the catalog) says 7.2 cu. ft., used here.
Abt's product page lists a power-on light; the only light in the catalog is the amber signal light.
The lid insulation is listed as bulk fiberglass; the cabinet wall insulation is not listed.
method: Part numbers come from the Electrolux factory parts catalog for product no. FFC0723DW0 (publication 5995415295, dated 04/08/18, cover: series 134A, 115 V, wiring diagram 216787900, energy guide 216793915), read as text on 2026-11-12.
The data sheet's circuit shows cold control, compressor, run capacitor and a compressor controller (catalog: 'Controller, compressor, 5 speed', 216954200).
Parts Town gives the same catalog name and a size of 2.6 x 1.7 x 1.55 in, 41 g.
The data sheet gives the temperature control as 9.5 F cut-in / -9.2 F cut-out at setting 1 and a wattage range of 65-85 (last third of cycle, 70 F room).
Ext/obs on extra parts are editorial.

comps.spec: Compressor without electricals, part 216951200 (system pos. 29), with mounting spring clip 216056400 and grommet 5308002681
Compressor controller (catalog: 'Controller, compressor, 5 speed'), part 216954200 (system pos. 30), held by clip 216954300
Run capacitor, 220 VAC, 12 microfarad, part 218909912 (system pos. 55)
Chest-type freezer with manual defrost, capacity 7.2 cu. ft.; Energy Guide 279 kWh per year (label 216793915, shared with FFC0723FW, FFC07K1FW, FFC0723GB)
